# Geekskai

> Geekskai is a browser-based collection of practical online tools and a local-first Audio Toolkit.

The Audio Toolkit processes audio locally in the user's browser. Audio files and filenames are not sent to Geekskai for processing. Signed-in users receive Audio Credits, and the estimated Credit cost appears before a batch starts.

## Product

- [Tools directory](https://geekskai.com/tools/): Browse public online tools
- [Audio Toolkit](https://geekskai.com/audio-toolkit/): Normalize and convert owned audio locally
- [Pricing](https://geekskai.com/pricing/): Compare daily Free, Pay As You Go, and Regular monthly Credits
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://geekskai.com/pricing.txt): Credit prices, expiry, and usage rules

## Current Audio Credit offers

- Free: 30 Credits per UTC day; one file per local batch
- Pay As You Go: 480 Credits for a $14 one-time payment; valid for 365 days
- Regular: 2,800 Credits for $29 per month; Credits expire at the end of each billing period
- 1 Credit covers one minute of combined input audio, rounded up once per batch
- Both paid offers support up to 50 local files per batch and ZIP export
- PayPal Business processes PAYG and recurring payments
- A full refund is available within 14 days only when no Credits from that payment were consumed
- Public downloader allowances remain separate free-product rules

## Trust and support

- [Privacy Policy](https://geekskai.com/privacy/): Account, payment, analytics, and local-processing data
- [Terms of Service](https://geekskai.com/terms/): Credits, acceptable use, subscriptions, and refunds
- Support: support@geekskai.com
